parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: commence division and reach a partial quotient of the form x² ± 3x, or compare coefficients in x⁴ − 3x³ + 9x² − 12x + 27 = (x² + 5)(Ax² + Bx + C) + Dx + E and reach A = 1 and B = ±3. A1: quotient x² − 3x + 4; A = 1, B = −3, with 5A + C = 9, 5B + D = −12 and 5C + E = 27. A1: remainder 3x + 7. A reversed pair stated as remainder x² − 3x + 4 and quotient 3x + 7 scores M1 A1 A0. [Total: 3]
